ctx.x: So tell me about some of these other guys. Where did you first run into a guy like Eubie Blake, I know he's been around. He's older than you.
Eubie I met in Boston. They came up there with a show and I was playing down in Leminster and they bought the show into Worchester and they got stranded. That was way back in 1918, I think.
Right after the war, because he was in that other band, wasn't he. Was Eubie in that band with -- what was his name, Jim Europe band.
